mantras.title: Sri Venkatesa Suprabhatam (verse 1)
mantras.textOriginal:
कौसल्या सुप्रजा राम पूर्वा सन्ध्या प्रवर्तते ।
उत्तिष्ठ नरशार्दूल कर्तव्यं दैवमाह्निकम् ॥
mantras.transliteration:
kausalyā suprajā rāma pūrvā sandhyā pravartate |
uttiṣṭha naraśārdūla kartavyaṃ daivamāhnikam ||
mantras.meaning: "Kausalyā's noble son Rāma, the eastern dawn is breaking. Arise, tiger among men; the day's sacred duties are to be done."
mantras.sourceText: Śrī Veṅkaṭeśa Suprabhātam (Prativādi Bhayaṅkaram Aṇṇan, 15th c.), verse 1 — itself Vālmīki Rāmāyaṇa, Bāla-kāṇḍa 23.2 (Viśvāmitra waking Rāma)
